denominator: Actual daily known-flow count in each fixed model/audit cell; days equally weighted within each cell, then cells averaged. Static3cells, dynamic9cells; all share date weights. Day-count table shows mean counts; per-cell CSV retains integer counts.
bootstrap: 2000 common28-calendar-day moving-block resamples, seed20261122; conditional temporal intervals, no family-wise significance claim.
p90: Linear empirical90th percentile per cell; bootstrap uses exact expanded-sample rank interpolation with calendar multiplicities.
